documents.text: Nimbus 3 supports Python 3.11 and Python 3.12. Python 3.10 is no longer supported.
Nimbus caches successful API responses for sixty seconds by default. Set cache_ttl_seconds to zero to disable this cache.
Nimbus accepts OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens. Static API keys are supported only by the legacy compatibility endpoint.
The client retries idempotent requests twice with exponential backoff. POST requests are not retried automatically.
Official Nimbus packages are published for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Configuration is loaded from nimbus.toml and then overridden by environment variables prefixed with NIMBUS_.
Structured JSON logging is enabled with log_format=json. The default console format is human readable.
A single upload may contain at most 100 files and each file may be at most 20 MiB.
